mapper.select: SELECT * FROM s_notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE s_notification SET read_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT n.* FROM s_notification n LEFT JOIN s_notification_delivery d ON d.notification_id = n.id AND d.channel = 'MOCK' WHERE n.type = 'CONTENT_ACTIVITY' AND d.id IS NULL ORDER BY n.id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE s_notification SET status = 'MOCK_SENT' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING_DELIVERY'
